name: University of Prince Edward Island
description:
Do you want to study at a university located on a scenic, beachy island in Canada?

At a university with a considerable global perspective, with over 5,500 students from more than 92 countries enrolled annually?

The University of Prince Edward Island has $ 11 million available in scholarships for students to unlock their potential, including international students.

The 17:9 student-to-faculty ratio shows its commitment to the student experience, with small class sizes and a large interaction between students and teachers.

UPEI is a recognised leader in sustainability initiatives amongst Canadian universities. The university has implemented numerous eco-friendly practices, such as a recycling program, energy-efficient buildings, and a strong focus on sustainable transportation options.

Discover why the University of Prince Edward Island might just be the place for you!

  • State-of-the-art athletic facilities, such as the Chi-Wan Young Sports Centre, UPEI Outdoor Artificial Turf Field, and Alumni Canada Games Place Track and Field

Student Life

The university's Student Affairs team offers many supports available for personal and academic success. This includes personal health and wellness, academic guidance, career development and health care services.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University Of Prince Edward Island is a public university in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island and was founded in 1969. However, its roots can be traced back to 1820 when Kent College was created as well St Dunstan's University in 1855 and Prince of Wales College in 1860. They were merged in 1969 to bring together the Island's religious communities.

It has just over 5,000 students, 1,600 of which are international students from more than 90 countries around the world. In Maclean's 2022 Guide to Canadian Universities, the University of Prince Edward Island was ranked seventh for "primarily undergraduate" Canadian universities. It also came 34th in the country for reputation.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UPEI offers residence halls with various room configurations, including single rooms and shared suites. 

Residence Life Advisors help international students to settle in and solve common queries.

Residence halls come with a kitchenette, shared bathrooms, TV lounges and laundry facilities as standard.

UPEI's Off-Campus Housing Office provides resources and listings to help students find suitable accommodation options off-campus in the nearby area too.

Some international students choose homestay programmes, where a local host family takes care of them and shows them the nearby area.
